tool_args.rationale: The pilot reaches s_grad 2.44, near but below the recalled critical range of 2.50–2.68. A high-gradient probe can distinguish a supercritical decline from competing smooth curves before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the avalanche, Haldane, or Cobb–Douglas model immediately
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five pilot observations couple u_now and s_grad and do not identify the behavior above the proposed critical gradient.
The unresolved question is the high-gradient threshold, not trajectory resolution.
It is irrelevant to identifying the proposed threshold.
